## Verification

## Review Checklist

- [ ] The change has one focused scope and aligns with the approved PRD/RFC, or documents an intentional decision change.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated, and tests are included when a testing workflow exists.
- [ ] Privacy and security boundaries are preserved; no raw typed content, credentials, tokens, or other secrets are included.
- [ ] Curriculum/content changes include item-level source, license, attribution, modification, and review provenance.
- [ ] Accessibility, keyboard-only use, reduced motion, localization, and supported layout effects were considered where relevant.
- [ ] Verification results and remaining limitations are stated clearly.
